title: 第21章 索兰特第22章 打听
lines: 看到海流沙点头，江来忍不住笑了起来，“万先生，你这种泡妞的手段未免太低劣了。不过也是，像她这种没见过世面的女人，很容易被你编的英雄事迹糊弄住。”
“糊弄？”海流沙柳眉微蹙，不悦道：“你什么意思？”
“流沙，别听他胡说八道。”万泉的眼中闪过一丝慌色，赶忙道：“跟他这种人没必要浪费唇舌，看我怎么收拾他。”话落，他大喝一声，飞身而起，一拳轰了过去。
然而，他还没近江来的身，就看到旁边冲出一道身影，狠狠地撞击在他身上。顿时，只见他的身体在半空中失去重心，砰的一声摔倒在地，痛得他呲牙咧嘴，英俊的脸庞都变了形，狰狞无比。
“喂！你们两个打一个，这是作弊。”阮香抱不平道。
比尔森淡淡的说道：“这种人不配做少爷的对手。”
看着半天爬不起来的万泉，江来慢慢蹲下身，一本正经的说道：“万先生，以后吹牛的时候别说你是上过战场的军人，不然很容易被人识破。真正经历过鲜血洗礼，见过战争残酷的军人，不会把它当成炫耀的资本。明白吗？”
万泉咬着牙，挣扎着从地上站起来，满脸怨愤，恨不得将江来千刀万剐，自己好不容易在海流沙面前经营的形象全被这家伙给毁了。
“董事长，您看……”阮香见气氛有些压抑，忍不住出声打破了众人间的沉默。
海流沙看了万泉一眼，又看了看神色淡漠的江来。刚才对方说出那番有关军人的话语时，她突然有种莫名的触动，恐怕只有经历过的人，才会有这样的感悟。
思忖间，一阵脚步声由远至近，从电梯方向传了过来。众人转头看去，只见一名身材高挑，穿着笔挺警服的漂亮女人出现在视线中。
“柳警官？”海流沙一怔，举步迎了上去，问道：“你今天怎么来了？”
“海小姐，我是来跟你聊聊前几天发生的爆炸案。”话落，柳初晴瞥了眼旁边的江来，心里有些奇怪，这家伙怎么会在这？
“柳警官。”阮香心急的问道：“案情有进展了吗？”
柳初晴点点头道：“经过对爆炸现场的还原，我们总算找到了一些线索。”
“这是我几天来听到最好的一个消息了。”海流沙微微一笑，“柳警官，我们进屋聊。”
眼见她二人进了办公室，江来和比尔森立刻尾随其后，独留万泉一个人在外面。后者犹豫了一下，咬咬牙，最后还是跟着进去了。
“海小姐，这是从现场收集到的炸弹残片，我花费几个通宵的时间，勉强将炸弹的形状复原。”柳初晴从随身携带的公文包中掏出一张照片，递到海流沙的手中。
阮香不解的问道：“柳警官，单凭一个炸弹能锁定嫌犯的身份吗？”
“这要看运气，一般来说很困难。但是，海小姐的运气不仅好到极点，同样也坏到几点。”
听到这话，众人云里雾里，不明白柳初晴的意思。见海流沙疑惑的目光投来，柳初晴解释道：“我们在炸弹的碎片上发现了一个独特的标志，从而锁定了犯罪嫌疑人，这是运气好的地方，但运气怀的是，这个犯罪嫌疑人的来头很大，是个极度危险的人物。”
“这个人叫索兰特，是国际刑警通缉多年的重犯，另外，他还是世界杀手榜排名第四的杀手，外号叫炸弹客，最喜欢用炸弹设下陷阱杀害目标。我查阅过资料，这个人行事非常谨慎，神出鬼没，让人防不胜防，有很多企业家和政客都死在他的手上。”
顿了顿，柳初晴又道：“据我所知，世界杀手榜每三年更新一次，但索兰特的排名从没跌出过前五，足见他的能力。”
“索兰特？”江来和比尔森交换了一个眼神，彼此的脸上都浮现出一丝诧异，竟然是这家伙！
content_en:
Seeing Hai Liusha nodding, Jiang Lai couldn't help but laugh, "Mr. Wan, your method of picking up girls is too cheap. However, a woman like her who has never seen the world can easily be fooled by your fabricated heroic deeds."
"Fooling?" Hailiu Shaliu frowned slightly and said displeasedly: "What do you mean?"
"Quisha, don't listen to his nonsense." A trace of panic flashed in Wan Quan's eyes, and he hurriedly said: "There is no need to waste your time with someone like him. See how I deal with him." After saying this, he shouted, flew up, and punched him.
However, before Omi could reach him, he saw a figure rushing out from beside him and hitting him hard. Suddenly, his body lost its center of gravity in mid-air and fell to the ground with a bang. He grinned in pain, and his handsome face was deformed, looking extremely hideous.
"Hey! You two are fighting each other. This is cheating." Ruan Xiang said unfairly.
Bilson said calmly: "This kind of person is not worthy of being the young master's opponent."
Looking at Wan Quan who couldn't get up for a long time, Jiang Lai slowly squatted down and said seriously: "Mr. Wan, when you brag in the future, don't say that you are a soldier who has been on the battlefield, otherwise it will be easy to be seen through. Soldiers who have truly experienced the baptism of blood and seen the cruelty of war will not regard it as a capital to show off. Do you understand?"
Wan Quan gritted his teeth and struggled to stand up from the ground. His face was full of resentment, and he wished he could cut Jiang Lai into pieces with a thousand knives. His image that he managed to manage in front of Hai Liusha was completely ruined by this guy.
"Chairman, look..." Seeing that the atmosphere was a bit depressing, Ruan Xiang couldn't help but break the silence among everyone.
Hai Liusha glanced at Wan Quan and then at Jiang Lai, who looked indifferent. When the other party said those words about soldiers just now, she suddenly felt inexplicably touched. I am afraid that only those who have experienced it can have such feelings.
While thinking about it, a sound of footsteps came from far to near, coming from the direction of the elevator. Everyone turned around and saw a tall, beautiful woman wearing a straight police uniform appearing in their sights.
"Officer Liu?" Hai Liusha was startled, stepped forward to greet him, and asked, "Why are you here today?"
"Miss Hai, I'm here to talk to you about the bombing that happened a few days ago." After saying this, Liu Chuqing glanced at Jiang Lai next to her, wondering why this guy was here?
"Officer Liu." Ruan Xiang asked anxiously, "Is there any progress in the case?"
Liu Chuqing nodded and said, "After reconstructing the explosion scene, we finally found some clues."
"This is the best news I've heard in the past few days." Hai Liusha smiled slightly, "Officer Liu, let's go inside and chat."
Seeing them enter the office, Jiang Lai and Bilson immediately followed them, leaving Wan Quan alone outside. The latter hesitated for a moment, gritted his teeth, and finally followed in.
"Ms. Hai, these are the bomb fragments collected from the scene. I spent several nights trying to restore the shape of the bomb." Liu Chuqing took out a photo from the briefcase he carried with him and handed it to Hai Liusha's hand.
Ruan Xiang asked in confusion: "Officer Liu, can a bomb alone identify the suspect?"
"It depends on luck, which is generally very difficult. However, Miss Hai's luck is not only extremely good, but also extremely bad."
After hearing this, everyone was confused and didn't understand what Liu Chuqing meant. Seeing Hai Liusha's doubtful gaze, Liu Chuqing explained: "We found a unique mark on the fragments of the bomb, and thus identified the suspect. This was a good thing, but the bad luck was that the suspect had a great background and was an extremely dangerous person."
"Who?"
"This man's name is Solant. He is a felon wanted by Interpol for many years. In addition, he is also the fourth-ranked killer on the world's killer list. His nickname is The Unabomber. He likes to use bombs to set traps to kill targets. I have checked the information and found that this man is very cautious, elusive and unpredictable. Many entrepreneurs and politicians have died at his hands."
After a pause, Liu Chuqing added: "As far as I know, the world killer list is updated every three years, but Solant's ranking has never fallen out of the top five, which shows his ability."
"Solant?" Jiang Lai and Bilson exchanged a look, with a hint of surprise on each other's faces, it turned out to be this guy!
